1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), __wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb is specifically a cytopathic strain__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, __wherein at least one of the viral-specific antigens is derived from the cytopathic BVDV-lb strain__.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, __wherein at least one of the modified live viruses is a cytopathic strain__.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, __wherein said first antigen is selected from the group consisting of viral or bacterial antigens associated with bovine diseases__. 

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated, __wherein said inactivated antigen is derived from a cytopathic virus or bacterium__. 

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen, __wherein said microbial pathogen-specific antigen is derived from a cytopathic strain__.
